name: @mickorz/pi-code-mode
description: 面向 Pi Agent 的代码式工作流编排插件：JavaScript DSL 调度多个 Agent、管理执行状态、恢复工作流

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.extensions.json && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const s='packages/engine/src/analyzer/';const d='dist/packages/engine/src/analyzer/';fs.mkdirSync(d+'dashboard',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync(s+'dashboard/template.html',d+'dashboard/template.html');fs.cpSync(s+'rules/definitions',d+'rules/definitions',{recursive:true})"
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:contract && npm run test:analyzer && npm run test:optimizer && npm run test:governance && npm run test:plan && npm run test:evaluator && npm run test:adaptive
